top.gloss: and you will give a sixth part of

entries.def: (Piel) to give the sixth part, give the sixth part of

1) gladness, joy, exultation, rejoicing
1a) exultation, joy

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.40 
§ Shashai = "noble"
a son of Bani who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra

sixty, three score
Aramaic equivalent: shit.tin (שִׁתִּין "sixty" H8361)

Sheshach = "thy fine linen"
another name for Babylon apparently taken from the goddess 'Shach'
Another name of ba.vel (בָּבֶ֫ל, בָּבֶל "Babylon" H0894)
